newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Atlantis firm sets IPO price at 5-7 zlotys.
newsitem.headline: Polish Atlantis firm sets IPO price at 5-7 zlotys.

text.p: The Polish construction and trading firm Atlantis SA set the price of its initial public offering at between five and seven zlotys per share, the firm said in an issue prospectus on Saturday.
The company, which seeks a main market listing, offers 3.5 million shares in the large investor tranche and 1.5 million shares in the retail tranche from April 7 to 18.

The final price, the same for both tranches, will be set by the supervisory board on the basis of the book building process and announced at least two days before the start of the subscription, the prospectus said.
Investors will have to subscribe to at least three million shares for the issue to become effective.
The company, controlled in 88 percent by a private investor earned net 1.6 million zlotys on sales of 39 million.
The company has 7.4 million shares outstanding.
